upstream.notes: Real mermaid 11.16.0 classDiagram geometry captured via headless Chrome with the bundled Noto fonts. Every class and note with its centre, its outline (in the node's own coordinates), its dividers (from the node's left edge to its right, as the first and last point of the divider path) and its text rows (annotation, name, members, methods; the note's text), every relationship with its paths (the waypoints the layout gave each, which the path carries, and the path's data), its pattern, markers, label and cardinalities (their text box and the box clipped to), every namespace with its box and title, and the canvas (the content's bounding box, as the SVG's getBBox() reports it), all but the node-local parts normalized to the centre of the first declared class. Compare, through the render cache, against classdiagram::ClassScene.

oracle: classDiagram.render classes, notes, relationship paths, namespaces and canvas (first-class normalized)
